# C++ standard library exception classes, one `child parent` pair per line, without the
# `std::` qualifier (`filesystem_error` is `std::filesystem::filesystem_error`).
# Runtime: Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101), libc++, -std=c++17.
# Produced by compiling and running this program (`clang++ -std=c++17`), which asks the
# compiler for each class's bases with std::is_base_of:
#   #include <any>
#   #include <exception>
#   #include <filesystem>
#   #include <functional>
#   #include <future>
#   #include <iostream>
#   #include <memory>

#   #include <system_error>
#   #include <type_traits>
#   #include <typeinfo>
#   #include <variant>
#   #include <vector>
#   using namespace std;
#   using filesystem_error = filesystem::filesystem_error;
#   #define LIST(X) X(exception) X(logic_error) X(invalid_argument) X(domain_error) X(length_error) \
#       X(out_of_range) X(future_error) X(runtime_error) X(range_error) X(overflow_error) \
#       X(underflow_error) X(regex_error) X(system_error) X(filesystem_error) X(bad_typeid) \
#       X(bad_cast) X(bad_any_cast) X(bad_optional_access) X(bad_weak_ptr) X(bad_function_call) \
#       X(bad_alloc) X(bad_array_new_length) X(bad_exception) X(bad_variant_access)
#   #define ALL(X) LIST(X)
#   #define ALL2(X) LIST(X)
#   // How many of the listed classes are proper bases of B.
#   template <class B> size_t depth() {
#   #define COUNT(A) + (is_base_of<A, B>::value && !is_same<A, B>::value ? 1 : 0)
#       return 0 ALL(COUNT);
#   }
#   template <class B, class D> void candidate(const char* name, string& best, size_t& deepest) {
#       if (is_base_of<B, D>::value && !is_same<B, D>::value && depth<B>() + 1 > deepest) {
#           deepest = depth<B>() + 1;
#           best = name;
#       }
#   }
#   // The direct base of D among the listed classes: its proper base that has the most bases.
#   template <class D> void row(const char* name) {
#       string best;
#       size_t deepest = 0;
#   #define CANDIDATE(B) candidate<B, D>(#B, best, deepest);
#       ALL(CANDIDATE)
#       if (!best.empty()) cout << name << " " << best << "\n";
#   }
#   #define ROW(D) row<D>(#D);
#   int main() { ALL2(ROW) }
